sites.name: Tran Temple Historical Relic Site
sites.event: The place of worship for the kings of the Tran Dynasty and meritorious mandarins, famous for the early spring Tran Temple Seal Opening Ceremony to pray for national peace and prosperity.

sites.name: Phu Day
sites.event: The center of the belief in the Mother Goddesses of Three Realms (Representative Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity), where Holy Mother Lieu Hanh is worshipped.

sites.name: Xuan Thuy National Park
sites.event: The first Ramsar site in Vietnam and Southeast Asia, an important stopover for thousands of rare migratory bird species.

sites.name: Hai Ly Ruined Church (Heart Church)
sites.event: An evidence of coastal erosion and climate change, the ruins of St. Maria Madalena Church by the beach.

sites.name: Co Le Pagoda (Than Quang Tu)
sites.event: The pagoda is famous for the Cuu Pham Lien Hoa tower and the history of monks who 'shed their Buddhist robes to wear military uniforms' to join the resistance.

sites.name: Phu Nhai Basilica
sites.event: One of the largest and most beautiful Catholic churches in Vietnam, featuring magnificent Gothic architecture.

sites.name: Pho Minh Tower
sites.event: A typical brick architectural work of the Tran Dynasty (1305), a symbol of Truc Lam Buddhism and the Dong A spirit.

sites.name: Chua Luong Tile-roofed Bridge
sites.event: One of the three most beautiful ancient tile-roofed bridges in Vietnam (along with Thanh Toan Tile-roofed Bridge and Hoi An Covered Bridge), dating back more than 500 years.

sites.name: Thinh Long Beach
sites.event: A long beach with rows of sand-blocking casuarina trees, a famous summer resort destination of the province.

sites.name: Keo Hanh Thien Pagoda
sites.event: An ancient pagoda with unique wooden architecture, worshipping Zen Master Duong Khong Lo, associated with the standing rowing festival.

sites.name: Memorial House of the Late General Secretary Truong Chinh
sites.event: The birthplace and childhood home of Comrade Truong Chinh, an outstanding leader of the Vietnamese Revolution.
